name: foreach-array-tests-6709ca3e0f/foreach-array-remove-elements-p.bal
spec_references: ## Statements: Foreach — Currently only supports range, list, map, string and XML subtypes, and iterable objects

# Subset restrictions / ## Import declarations: Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported; ballerina/lang.array lists length, push, map, indexOf, remove, removeAll, toStream, toBase64, toBase16, fromBase64, fromBase16

## Invocations / ### Other invocation restrictions: Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions: array:length, array:push, array:map, array:indexOf, array:remove, array:removeAll, array:toStream, array:toBase64, array:toBase16
reason: The test requires values.pop(), but array:pop is absent from both the supported array library functions and the langlib method-call whitelist. Although foreach over an int array is supported, this essential unsupported mutation prevents classifying the whole panic test as a bug.
test_design_notes: The @panic annotation asserts a panic while removing elements during foreach iteration; merely accepting the function signatures or loop does not satisfy the test. No @args or @output annotations are present.
